Title: [VEG] Spanish Grand Prix Madrid / Alcala de Henares - 28th and 29th April 2018

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Madrid (in fact Alcala de Henares) – Spain (28th and 29th April 2018) – The Iberico GP
Organized by the coordinators of Spain and Portugal of V:EKN, the cultural association Alcala nocturnal and sponsored by the store Alcala comics and the city council of the city of Alcala de Henares.
Alcala de Henares, a World Heritage City, is a central town located 30 kilometers from Madrid, the capital of Spain.

The tournament will be held on Saturday 28th in its format prix, in addition to another tournament on Sunday 29th if the attendance is important enough.

The cultural center "La galatea" hosts both tournaments. This cultural center is located just 500 meters from the commercial park "Atenea"

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Juliog
Messages.Body:
About this cuestion :Is it a mistake or are the Iberian & Hungarian GPs the same weekend ?

Unfortunately, it is not an error. The Budapest coordinator has decided to put the budapest GP on the same date as the one in Spain. He has alleged ignorance despite the fact that since October of last year the gp Spain was assigned on that date. All this despite the fact that we had a mail group among the GP coordinators.
Orian the coordinator of all the GPs, who by the way did not know anything about this issue because nobody had informed him, is looking for a solution for this question. Personally, I have preferred not to comment on this as an involved party. If I can tell you, I'm very upset.

So for reasons beyond our control, we must delay the pre-registrations to the Iberian Grand Prix. We have had calendar problems in the GP circuit and we are at the expense of changing the background of the tournament. The dates continue being the same and we hope that during the week we will clarify the situation. In the beginning, the pre-registration will start next week

www.facebook.com/events/735293500007254/
